title: Do you actually need electrolytes? 🧂💧
caption:
For a normal hour in the gym, water and your meals cover it. Long, hot, sweaty sessions or heavy salty sweaters are different. Do you use electrolytes? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 9
